visual_text: Most people flagged by the surprise question were still alive
Pooled data: 16 studies, 11,621 patients, death within 6 to 18 months
Of 100 people flagged: 37 died in the window, 63 did not
Of 100 people who died: 67 had been flagged, 33 had not
Alive at the end of the window
Our view: a prompt for conversation, not a forecast. Worse in non-cancer illness; most studies at moderate to high risk of bias.
